lines.zh: 我一步一沉，走在山坡上。
lines.en: I trudge across the hillside, heavy at every step.

lines.zh: 我的长毛在风里往一边吹。
lines.en: My long coat blows to one side in the wind.
I walk slowly along the ridge.

lines.zh: 我的蹄子在碎石上打滑。
lines.en: My hooves slip on the loose stones.
I walk with my head low, horns forward.
I go round a boulder without stopping.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方草被压平。
lines.en: The grass flattens where I walk.
I shift toward the windy side.
I step along with great patience.
I walk along the stone wall.
I toss my head and the bell rings.
I turn slowly the other way.
I go down the slope, steady.

lines.zh: 我一边走一边吃两口草。
lines.en: I take two mouthfuls of grass as I walk.
I stop at the crest and catch my breath.

lines.zh: 我朝你那边慢慢走过去。
lines.en: I walk slowly toward your side.
I stand with my coat over my eyes.
I chew my cud slowly, a long while.
I squint into the wind.

lines.zh: 我把蹄子在地上刨了刨。
lines.en: I scrape the ground with a hoof.
I look down at the grass.
I shake the coat on my back.
I stand, tail swinging slowly.
I rest by the stone wall.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地呼气，白气出来。
lines.en: I breathe out slowly, and mist appears.
I rest my head on the low wall.
The wind is too strong; I turn my back to it.
I glance up at the clouds.
A few blades of grass cling to my coat.
I stand firm; the wind does not move me.
I chew slowly, eyes half shut.
I look out from the ridge.
You stand upwind of me.

lines.zh: 牦牛毛遮眼，我抬头看你。
lines.en: Yak fur in my eyes, I lift my head to you.
My horns are pointed at you.
Are you holding shears?
I am on the slope; you are below.
Do not come too close.
I watch you, chewing slowly.

lines.zh: 风把你的味道带过来了。
lines.en: The wind carries your scent to me.
I stand and let you pass first.
You carry a smell from beyond the hills.
I lift my chin.

lines.zh: 我还没决定要不要生气。
lines.en: I have not decided whether to be angry.
I step back and toss my head.
I give one short bellow.

lines.zh: 疼是疼，隔着这层毛还算轻。
lines.en: It stings, but this coat softens it.
I paw the ground, displeased.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转过身，护住侧腹。
lines.en: I turn slowly to guard my flank.
I hold my ground; I do not fall.
My breathing turns heavy.
You have made me angry.
I retreat to the stone wall.
I lower my head, horns out.
Is that wheat?

lines.zh: 山风这么大，我这身毛正好。
lines.en: The wind's this strong — my coat's just right.
I walk over to your hand.
Hold the grass a little higher.
I smell fresh grass.
Put it down and I will come.
I ease toward you.
That handful will not fill me.
I curl my tongue out once.
Do not put the grass away.
I raise my head, waiting for your hand.
I puff through my nose.
Spread the grass out; I will help myself.
My long coat hangs to the ground.
I know that sweet smell.

lines.zh: 我把头低下，凑到你手边。
lines.en: I lower my head to your hand.

lines.zh: 你撞到我，像撞到一堵墙。
lines.en: You hit me like hitting a wall.

lines.zh: 风袭丘陵的长毛，经得住一撞。
lines.en: My long coat takes a hit fine on the windswept hills.
I shoulder you once.
You hit my horns and pull back.
We knock and dust rises.
I stand on the path and do not move.
You push me and I only sway.

lines.zh: 风袭丘陵的草太短，挪不开。
lines.en: The grass here is too short to shift for you.
After we part, I shake my coat.
Not a heavy hit; a warning.
There are a few more on the hillside.
I am in no hurry about such things.
I lower my head and keep grazing.
That made me raise my head.
The wind is loud; I cannot hear.
I turn slowly the other way.
This coat of mine is warm enough.
I stand and give no answer.
I walk off toward the stone wall.
I swish my tail.
I curl it up with my tongue and eat.
I lower my head and take a mouthful of grass.
I cannot chew this one.
I press it under a hoof.
I sniff it and do not eat.
I take it and chew slowly.

lines.zh: 我这一身长毛，拖到地上。
lines.en: My long hair drags on the ground.
I eat whatever grass falls.
I lift my head and grass hangs on my horns.
I nudge it aside.
I raise my horns your way.
The windswept hills ruffle my coat.
I start walking toward you.

lines.zh: 剪我的毛之前先问一声。
lines.en: Ask before you shear me.
I want this spot.
I have noted where you are.
I walk slowly down the slope.

lines.zh: 你那件红衣服惹到我了。
lines.en: That red coat of yours provoked me.
I turn in your direction.
I have not finished this grass.
I keep walking your way.
You step back, and then I move.
I go round the stone and keep coming.
You shift a foot, I crowd a foot.
I press forward one step at a time.
You stop, and I stop to graze.
I am upwind and can smell you clearly.
I lower my head and walk at you.
The closer you get to the wall, the nearer I come.

lines.zh: 我一直看着你，没有眨眼。
lines.en: I watch you without blinking.
I lower my head and charge.
My horns catch your shoulder.

lines.zh: 这一下把你推得退了很远。
lines.en: That shoved you far back.
I strike you with a forehoof.
You are knocked against the stone wall.
Heavy, not sharp.
I turn and take you with my shoulder.
I headbutt and stay right here.

lines.zh: 这一下带着一身毛的重。
lines.en: That blow carried a coat's worth of weight.
After the charge I shake my head.
I come down from the ridge.
You see a mass of thick coat first.

lines.zh: 我在坡上站着，风把毛吹起来。
lines.en: I stand on the slope, wind lifting my coat.
I step out from behind the stone wall.
I land, hooves heavy.

lines.zh: 云散了一点，我就在那儿。
lines.en: The cloud thins a little, and there I am.
I come slowly around the spur.
There is one more yak in this area.

lines.zh: 我把头从草丛里抬起来。
lines.en: I raise my head out of the grass.
I reach the crest and stop.

lines.zh: 火燎到毛，我跳起来甩了几下。
lines.en: Fire catches my coat and I buck a few times.

lines.zh: 我从坡上滚下，摔进草里。
lines.en: I roll down the slope into the grass.

lines.zh: 水灌进来，我努力往岸上爬。
lines.en: Water floods my nose and I struggle for the bank.
The blast rolls me onto my back.
The arrow sticks in my coat, not the flesh.
Magic hits and I sway.

lines.zh: 草被雪埋了，我越来越瘦。
lines.en: Snow covers the grass, and I grow thin.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，我带着一身毛跳起。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and I leap, coat and all.
The void pulls and my hooves search for ground.
